title: Larkspur Credit Cards Underwriting Criteria, Security Deposits and Credit Limits
content:
Each card in the Larkspur Credit Cards line-up, from the Larkspur Secured Visa (lowest) to the Larkspur Travel Rewards Visa Signature (highest), has its own entry criteria and credit limit range. The figures below are the product terms for every card; amounts are in USD.

## Entry criteria and limits by card

| Term | Larkspur Secured Visa | Larkspur Classic Visa | Larkspur Cash Back Visa | Larkspur Balance Transfer Visa Platinum | Larkspur Cash Back Visa Signature | Larkspur Travel Rewards Visa Signature |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Minimum FICO Score 8 at application | none | 600 | 670 | 690 | 720 | 740 |
| Minimum stated gross annual income | 0 | 18000 | 30000 | 35000 | 50000 | 60000 |
| Minimum refundable security deposit | 200 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Maximum security deposit | 2500 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Lowest credit limit | 200 | 500 | 1000 | 2000 | 5000 | 5000 |
| Highest credit limit | 2500 | 5000 | 15000 | 20000 | 30000 | 30000 |
| Graduation review, months after opening | 7 | not offered | not offered | not offered | not offered | not offered |
| Months after opening (or after the last increase) before a limit increase is considered | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| Most open card accounts a customer may hold | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |

## Notes on the terms

- **Credit score.** The score is the applicant's FICO Score 8 at application. "None" means no minimum applies; this is the case only for the Larkspur Secured Visa.
- **Income.** The income figure is the applicant's stated gross annual income. The Larkspur Secured Visa minimum is 0.
- **Security deposit.** The minimum refundable security deposit equals the credit limit, and is 0 for unsecured cards. The maximum security deposit is likewise 0 for unsecured cards. Only the Larkspur Secured Visa takes a deposit, from 200 to 2500.
- **Graduation review.** Only a Larkspur Secured Visa account is reviewed for an upgrade to the Larkspur Classic Visa, 7 months after opening. Every other card shows "not offered".
- **Limit increases.** On every card, a limit increase is considered 6 months after opening, or 6 months after the last increase.
- **Open accounts.** A customer may hold at most 2 open Larkspur card accounts, whichever cards they are.

## Reading the table: questions answered

**Which card has no minimum credit score?** Only the Larkspur Secured Visa. Every other card names a minimum score, rising with the card's rank from 600 to 740.

**Do two cards share the same limit range?** Yes. The Larkspur Cash Back Visa Signature and the Larkspur Travel Rewards Visa Signature both run from 5000 to 30000. They differ in minimum score (720 against 740) and minimum income (50000 against 60000).

**Hypothetical example of reading the criteria.** Take an invented applicant with a stated income of 40000 and a FICO Score 8 of 700. Measured against the table, they reach the score and income minimums of the Larkspur Classic Visa, the Larkspur Cash Back Visa and the Larkspur Balance Transfer Visa Platinum. They do not reach those of the two Visa Signature cards, because 700 is below 720 and 40000 is below 50000. The example illustrates how to read the score and income rows only.
